title: Mununu register-map sidecar
description: Schema for the HW/SW codesign register-map sidecar (Document C task C1). A descriptive specification of a memory-mapped peripheral's register layout, with per-field mappings to the SV signal path and the C accessor expression. Coupling synthesis (Task C2) consumes this file plus the two extracted automata to produce a unified AdapterIR. The exact path on disk is conventionally `.mununu/coupling/register_maps/<peripheral>.json` but is not enforced by the schema.

peripheral.description: Logical name of the peripheral, e.g. UART_LITE.

base_address.description: Base address as a string so hex literals round-trip exactly. Accepts 0x… / 0b… / plain decimal.

registers.description: Ordered list of register definitions. Order is preserved on disk for human readability; lookups go by name.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the peripheral.

contract_uri.description: Optional reference to a corpus contract describing this peripheral's external interface, e.g. contract://rtl_protocol/axi4_lite_slave@1.0.0.

name.description: Register name as it appears in the datasheet.

offset.description: Byte offset from the peripheral base.

width_bits.description: Register width in bits — typically 8, 16, 32, or 64.

direction.description: Direction relative to firmware: RW (firmware reads + writes; peripheral may also update), RO (firmware reads; peripheral writes), WO (firmware writes; peripheral reacts).

visibility_class.description: Standard concurrency-semantics class. Defaults to `other` when omitted.

access_path.description: How firmware reaches the register. Defaults to `mmio_direct` when omitted.

fields.description: Ordered list of bit-fields inside the register.

bits.description: Bit range as [low, high] (inclusive). [0, 0] is a single bit at position 0.

sv_signal.description: SV signal path this field maps onto, e.g. uart_inst.ctrl_reg[0]. Empty until authored.

c_accessor.description: C accessor expression, e.g. UART->CTRL.bit.tx_start. Empty until authored.
